title: Dadi's Digital Eye
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

dadi_kusum.look: An old woman, 70s, strict but loving, wrinkles around eyes, silver hair tied in a neat bun, traditional glasses, crisp white cotton saree with a red border, a serious expression. Fair, light wheatish skin, bright soft light on the face.

priya.look: A young woman, 20s, graceful and pretty, long soft wavy dark-brown hair, small bindi, simple silver earrings, elegant pastel green kurta, jeans. Fair, light wheatish skin, bright soft light on the face. Patient, kind expression.

scenes.image: A strict old woman, Dadi Kusum, glares at a brightly glowing smartphone screen held by a young woman, Priya. Dadi's eyes are wide in disapproval. Close-up.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Meri Dadi ne kabhi tech ko haath nahin lagaya tha.
scenes.say: मेरी दादी ने कभी टेक को हाथ नहीं लगाया था।

scenes.image: Dadi Kusum sits on a traditional wooden chair, hands folded tightly, looking away from Priya, who is holding out a new smartphone with a hopeful smile.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, please, ek baar try toh karo.
scenes.say: दादी, प्लीज़, एक बार ट्राई तो करो।

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi Kusum's stern face, her mouth a thin line, refusing to even look at the phone.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Yeh sab fizool hai. Mujhe nahin chahiye.
scenes.say: ये सब फ़िज़ूल है। मुझे नहीं चाहिए।

scenes.image: Priya gently places the smartphone on Dadi's lap, Dadi eyes it suspiciously like a ticking bomb.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya ne bahut zor lagaya tha.
scenes.say: प्रिया ने बहुत ज़ोर लगाया था।

scenes.image: Dadi Kusum reluctantly picks up the phone with two fingers, holding it far away from herself, a look of extreme caution.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dekho, iss button se on hota hai.
scenes.say: देखो, इस बटन से ऑन होता है।

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi's hand, fumbling with the power button. Her fingers look unsure and hesitant.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Itna chhota sa button? Yeh kaise?
scenes.say: इतना छोटा सा बटन? ये कैसे?

scenes.image: The phone screen lights up with a colorful wallpaper. Dadi's eyes widen slightly in surprise.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Screen par colors dekh kar, Dadi thodi hairan hui.
scenes.say: स्क्रीन पर कलर्स देख कर, दादी थोड़ी हैरान हुई।

scenes.image: Priya demonstrates swiping the screen. Dadi watches with intense focus, mimicking the movement with her finger in the air.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Aise swipe karo, aur apps aa jaayenge.
scenes.say: ऐसे स्वाइप करो, और ऐप्स आ जाएँगे।

scenes.image: Dadi tries to swipe, but her finger presses too hard, leaving a smudge. She looks frustrated.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Yeh toh chal hi nahin raha! Chipak gaya hai.
scenes.say: ये तो चल ही नहीं रहा! चिपक गया है।

scenes.image: Priya laughs softly, gently guiding Dadi's finger across the screen. Dadi looks annoyed but follows.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Thoda halke haathon se, Dadi.
scenes.say: थोड़ा हल्के हाथों से, दादी।

scenes.image: Priya opens the camera app. Dadi looks confused at her own reflection on screen.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dekho, yeh camera hai! Aap apni photo kheench sakti ho.
scenes.say: देखो, ये कैमरा है! आप अपनी फोटो खींच सकती हो!

scenes.image: Dadi tries to take a selfie. She holds the phone too close, her face comically distorted on screen.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Arre, yeh kya ho gaya? Mera chehra!
scenes.say: अरे, ये क्या हो गया? मेरा चेहरा!

scenes.image: Close-up of the phone screen showing Dadi's exaggerated, squashed face. Priya tries to stifle her laughter.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Selfies lena Dadi ke liye ek mission tha.
scenes.say: सेल्फ़ीज़ लेना दादी के लिए एक मिशन था।

scenes.image: Dadi accidentally switches to the rear camera, pointing it at the ceiling. She looks puzzled.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Ab kahan chala gaya mera chehra?
scenes.say: अब कहाँ चला गया मेरा चेहरा?

scenes.image: Priya helps Dadi find the front camera again, patiently explaining. Dadi nods, still looking baffled.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Yeh dekho, iss button se switch karte hain.
scenes.say: ये देखो, इस बटन से स्विच करते हैं।

scenes.image: Dadi tries to make a call. She struggles to tap the small numbers on the dial pad.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Itne chhootey akshar! Mujhe dikh nahin rahe.
scenes.say: इतने छोटे अक्षर! मुझे दिख नहीं रहे।

scenes.image: Priya helps Dadi dial a family member. Dadi holds the phone like a precious artifact, far from her ear.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Phone kaan ke paas rakho, Dadi.
scenes.say: फ़ोन कान के पास रखो, दादी।

scenes.image: The family member answers. Dadi speaks loudly into the phone, as if they are far away.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Hellooo! Kya meri awaaz aa rahi hai?
scenes.say: हेल्लोओओ! क्या मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?

scenes.image: Priya winces, gently telling Dadi to lower her voice. Dadi looks annoyed at being corrected.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, thoda dheere, yeh speaker nahin hai.
scenes.say: दादी, थोड़ा धीरे, ये स्पीकर नहीं है।

scenes.image: Dadi tries to send a message. She pecks at the keyboard with one finger, very slowly.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: M-A-I... Kitna mushkil hai yeh!
scenes.say: म-ए-ई... कितना मुश्किल है ये!

scenes.image: The message takes forever. Priya sighs, but smiles, knowing Dadi is trying her best.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya ki patience ka test ho raha tha.
scenes.say: प्रिया की पेशेंस का टेस्ट हो रहा था।

scenes.image: Dadi accidentally types gibberish and sends it. She looks horrified.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Oh Bhagwan! Yeh kya bhej diya maine?
scenes.say: ओह भगवान! ये क्या भेज दिया मैंने?

scenes.image: Priya quickly deletes the message. Dadi looks relieved but still very confused by the technology.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Koi baat nahin, Dadi. Hota hai.
scenes.say: कोई बात नहीं, दादी। होता है।

scenes.image: Dadi puts the phone down with a huff, crossing her arms, looking defeated.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Main toh haar maan gayi. Yeh mere bas ka nahin.
scenes.say: मैं तो हार मान गई। ये मेरे बस का नहीं।

scenes.image: Priya picks up the phone, showing Dadi a video call screen with a smiling relative. Dadi's expression changes to curiosity.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dekho, yeh video call hai. Aap unhein dekh sakti ho!
scenes.say: देखो, ये वीडियो कॉल है। आप उन्हें देख सकती हो!

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi's face, her eyes wide with amazement as she sees her relative moving and talking on the screen.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Arre wah! Yeh toh jaadu hai!
scenes.say: अरे वाह! ये तो जादू है!

scenes.image: Dadi reaches out to touch the screen, trying to physically connect with the person on the call.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Beta, kaise ho? Tum itne patle ho gaye!
scenes.say: बेटा, कैसे हो? तुम इतने पतले हो गए!

scenes.image: Priya explains it's just a screen. Dadi is fascinated by the real-time interaction.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Video calls ne Dadi ka interest jaga diya.
scenes.say: वीडियो कॉल्स ने दादी का इंटरेस्ट जगा दिया।

scenes.image: Later, Dadi is now holding the phone, intently watching a video. Priya looks on, amused.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Achha, ab aap video dekh rahi ho?
scenes.say: अच्छा, अब आप वीडियो देख रही हो?

scenes.image: Dadi pauses the video, turns to Priya with a serious expression.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Priya, yeh dekho! Pados wali aunty kya kar rahi hai?
scenes.say: प्रिया, ये देखो! पड़ोस वाली आँटी क्या कर रही है?

scenes.image: Close-up of the phone screen, showing a blurry, zoomed-in shot of a neighbor's house from a window.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadi ne neighborhood watch shuru kar di thi.
scenes.say: दादी ने नेबरहुड वॉच शुरू कर दी थी।

scenes.image: Dadi points a stern finger at the screen, then at Priya.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Woh dekho, unka beta subah se park mein hai.
scenes.say: वो देखो, उनका बेटा सुबह से पार्क में है।

scenes.image: Priya looks confused. 'How did you see that?' she thinks. Dadi's face is triumphant.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, aapko kaise pata chala?
scenes.say: दादी, आपको कैसे पता चला?

scenes.image: Dadi taps the screen, showing Priya a live video feed from a public park. Priya is shocked.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Maine ek app download kar liya. Sab dikhta hai.
scenes.say: मैंने एक ऐप डाउनलोड कर लिया। सब दिखता है।

scenes.image: Priya's jaw drops. Dadi smirks, adjusting her glasses, very pleased with herself.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya ko Dadi ka naya talent samajh nahin aaya.
scenes.say: प्रिया को दादी का नया टैलेंट समझ नहीं आया।

scenes.image: A week later, Dadi is on a video call with her sister (another old woman, similar traditional look). They are both intently watching something.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Aur dekho, uss Sharma ji ki bahu ne aaj phir kapde late dhoye.
scenes.say: और देखो, उस शर्मा जी की बहू ने आज फिर कपड़े लेट धोए।

scenes.image: The sister on the screen nods vigorously, agreeing with Dadi's observation.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Bilkul theek! Humari society ke rules nahin follow hote.
scenes.say: बिल्कुल ठीक! हमारी सोसाइटी के रूल्स नहीं फॉलो होते।

scenes.image: Priya walks in, sees Dadi's 'surveillance operation'. She looks a mix of amused and horrified.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, aap yeh kya kar rahi ho?
scenes.say: दादी, आप ये क्या कर रही हो?

scenes.image: Dadi quickly minimizes the video, tries to act innocent, but her smile gives her away.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Kuch nahin, beta. Bas khabar le rahi hoon.
scenes.say: कुछ नहीं, बेटा। बस खबर ले रही हूँ।

scenes.image: Priya picks up the phone. On the screen, she sees a carefully organized folder of apps named 'Nazar Rakhna' (Keeping an Eye).
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Nazar Rakhna? Yeh kya hai?
scenes.say: नज़र रखना? ये क्या है?

scenes.image: Dadi snatches the phone back, looking defensive but proud.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Woh sab meri research hai! Society ke liye.
scenes.say: वो सब मेरी रिसर्च है! सोसाइटी के लिए।

scenes.image: Priya discovers a list of scheduled video calls in Dadi's calendar, all labeled with names of family and neighbors.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadi ne ek pura network bana liya tha.
scenes.say: दादी ने एक पूरा नेटवर्क बना लिया था।

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi's phone, showing 'Ramesh's Study Check - 8 PM', 'Pooja's Kitchen Cleanliness - 10 AM'.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, aap in sab par nazar rakh rahi ho?
scenes.say: दादी, आप इन सब पर नज़र रख रही हो?

scenes.image: Dadi nods gravely, adjusting her glasses. Her expression is utterly serious.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Zaroori hai, beta. Koi toh karega.
scenes.say: ज़रूरी है, बेटा। कोई तो करेगा।

scenes.image: Priya sees a live feed of her cousin studying, with Dadi's sister on a small window, both critiquing his posture.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Dekha? Woh phir jhuk kar padh raha hai.
scenes.say: देखा? वो फिर झुक कर पढ़ रहा है।

scenes.image: Priya is speechless, her mouth open in disbelief. Dadi is entirely focused on the screen.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadi, ab ek digital detective ban chuki thi.
scenes.say: दादी, अब एक डिजिटल डिटेक्टिव बन चुकी थी।

scenes.image: Dadi gets a notification. She taps it. It's a group chat with other grandmas, 'Society Watch Committee.'
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Oh! New report aa gayi hai.
scenes.say: ओह! न्यू रिपोर्ट आ गई है।

scenes.image: Close-up of the chat: 'Mrs. Sharma: I saw the milkman today, he was late by 5 mins!' Dadi types furiously.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Maine bhi dekha! Yeh galti nahin chalegi.
scenes.say: मैंने भी देखा! ये गलती नहीं चलेगी।

scenes.image: Priya looks over Dadi's shoulder, witnessing the digital 'strictness' firsthand.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, aap toh poori CID officer ban gayi!
scenes.say: दादी, आप तो पूरी सीआईडी ऑफिसर बन गई!

scenes.image: Dadi gives Priya a stern look, holding up a finger.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Discipline bahut zaroori hai, Priya.
scenes.say: डिसिप्लिन बहुत ज़रूरी है, प्रिया।

scenes.image: Priya sees a new app: 'Priya's Social Life Tracker'. Her eyes widen in horror.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, yeh mere phone mein kya hai?
scenes.say: दादी, ये मेरे फोन में क्या है?

scenes.image: Dadi gives a mischievous smile, then quickly composes herself.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Woh toh... tumhari safety ke liye hai, beta.
scenes.say: वो तो... तुम्हारी सेफ्टी के लिए है, बेटा।

scenes.image: Priya scrolls through the app, seeing her call logs, message counts, and frequently visited locations. All tracked.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya ko Dadi ki asli intention pata chali.
scenes.say: प्रिया को दादी की असली इंटेंशन पता चली।

scenes.image: Priya confronts Dadi, pointing at the phone, a look of exasperation.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dadi, aap mera phone track kar rahi ho?
scenes.say: दादी, आप मेरा फोन ट्रैक कर रही हो?

scenes.image: Dadi calmly sips her tea, pretending not to hear, but a faint smile plays on her lips.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Kya? Mujhe kuch sunai nahin diya.
scenes.say: क्या? मुझे कुछ सुनाई नहीं दिया।

scenes.image: Priya tries to delete the tracking app. Dadi instantly snatches the phone away.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Haan, main kar rahi hoon. Aur yeh delete nahin hoga.
scenes.say: हाँ, मैं कर रही हूँ। और ये डिलीट नहीं होगा।

scenes.image: Dadi taps the screen, showing Priya a new feature: a live map of the entire neighborhood with little dots representing people.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Yeh kya hai? Yeh toh poora GPS hai!
scenes.say: ये क्या है? ये तो पूरा जीपीएस है!

scenes.image: Dadi points at a specific dot moving away from a house.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Woh dekho, Raju subah-subah gym jaane ke bahane park ja raha hai.
scenes.say: वो देखो, राजू सुबह-सुबह जिम जाने के बहाने पार्क जा रहा है।

scenes.image: Priya is completely stunned, her hands flying to her head in disbelief.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadi ne neighborhood ko apne control mein le liya tha.
scenes.say: दादी ने नेबरहुड को अपने कंट्रोल में ले लिया था।

scenes.image: Dadi is now sitting proudly with her phone, a regal, all-knowing expression.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Koi bhi galti se bhi galat kadam nahin uthayega.
scenes.say: कोई भी गलती से भी गलत कदम नहीं उठाएगा।

scenes.image: Priya is slumped on the sofa, utterly defeated, while Dadi continues monitoring.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Meri Dadi toh ab ek super-spy ban gayi hai!
scenes.say: मेरी दादी तो अब एक सुपर-स्पाई बन गई है!

scenes.image: Dadi is on a video call, pointing the phone towards the kitchen. A faint sound of someone not washing dishes properly.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Arre maid, bartan theek se dho! Dhyaan se.
scenes.say: अरे मेड, बर्तन ठीक से धो! ध्यान से।

scenes.image: The maid, visible through the video call, looks up in shock, wondering how Dadi knew.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Dadi ki 'digital eye' har jagah thi.
scenes.say: दादी की 'डिजिटल आई' हर जगह थी।

scenes.image: Close-up of Dadi's triumphant face, a mischievous glint in her eye.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Ab koi shaitani nahin chalegi.
scenes.say: अब कोई शैतानी नहीं चलेगी।

scenes.image: Priya holds her head, shaking it slowly. The strict grandma is now stricter with tech.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Technology ne Dadi ko aur powerful bana diya.
scenes.say: टेक्नोलॉजी ने दादी को और पावरफुल बना दिया।

scenes.image: Dadi is now wearing a headset, looking like a call center operator, but with a serious, commanding expression.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Achha, suno. Aaj shaam ka khana time par banna chahiye.
scenes.say: अच्छा, सुनो। आज शाम का खाना टाइम पर बनना चाहिए।

scenes.image: Priya looks directly at the camera, utterly resigned, gesturing at Dadi.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Maine toh socha tha, phone se Dadi modern banengi.
scenes.say: मैंने तो सोचा था, फोन से दादी मॉडर्न बनेंगी।

scenes.image: Dadi turns to Priya, a slight smirk.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Main toh hamesha modern hi thi, beta.
scenes.say: मैं तो हमेशा मॉडर्न ही थी, बेटा।

scenes.image: Dadi points her phone at Priya, who flinches, as if Dadi is going to scan her.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Bas ab mere paas behtar tools hain.
scenes.say: बस अब मेरे पास बेहतर टूल्स हैं।

scenes.image: Dadi is seen on a large screen, like a big boss, giving orders to her virtual 'committee' of grandmas, all holding phones.
scenes.speaker: dadi_kusum
scenes.line: Toh batao, aaj kisne rules tode?
scenes.say: तो बताओ, आज किसने रूल्स तोड़े?

caption: My Strict Grandma Got a Smartphone... And Became a Digital Spy 📱
yt_title: My Strict Grandma Got a Smartphone... And Became a Digital Spy 📱
description: My grandma never touched tech. Then she got a phone. You won't believe how she uses it! Is your grandma secretly a tech guru too?
comment_question: Would your Dadi use a smartphone like this?
